bundle.shortDescription: Watches for new releases anywhere and tells you the moment one appears
bundle.longDescription: Spotter watches folders and shares, HTTP listings, JSON APIs, forges, feeds and web pages (including JavaScript-rendered ones) for new releases and tells you the moment one appears. Everything stays on your machine.
